environment: Godot 4.6.3 / macOS / Apple M1 Pro / Metal Forward+; graphical tests run in isolated windowed source fixture
changes: Indoor furniture snaps within0.45m of a wall onto its face/skirting clearance, including normal placement/move and selected rotation; exact coordinates persist while structural half-metre grid remains enforced
Storage cabinet and bookshelf wall checks use solid-body bounds; floor support and furniture overlap retain their larger footprints; wall penetration still rejected
WASD and Shift-right drag pan in the current camera yaw rather than fixed world axes; actual mouse/key events tested at four orientations

lighting_source.behavior: Existing room script sets light energy by day/night; no user-placed fixtures required. Bedside lamp shade has a little emissive material, but no corresponding light source in player-built rooms. This follow-up explains the behavior and does not alter it.

preserved: No automatic relocation of existing saved furniture, map regeneration, player-save writes, version bump, export, upload, commit, push or server action. Existing single-player build schema1 retained; no global or multiplayer regression.
